scope: Cross-language and representation translation for Frankenmine; primary-source research only; no installs, donor execution, or external mutation.

records.title: Automated Software Transplantation — Chapter 5: Multilingual Software Transplantation (τTrans/τScalpel)
records.what_transfers: Translate common language constructs with deterministic rules, leave API-specific holes, synthesize those holes under transplanted-organ tests. Demonstrates Java→Swift and Fortran→Python, not universal language support.
records.limitations: Reported ten organs/two language pairs; new pairs require a shared-core translator. Full PDF fetch timed out; relevant chapter excerpts were retrieved through indexed primary-PDF search. No τScalpel source repository or license verified.
records.opensource_status: Thesis publicly accessible; implementation availability and license unverified.
records.inspection_depth: UCL publication metadata and primary-PDF indexed §§5.1,5.4.5 excerpts; not executed.

records.title: C2Rust
records.type: Usable open-source transpiler and migration toolchain
records.what_transfers: C99→Rust transpilation followed by refactoring, optional LLM cleanup, and source/translation cross-checks. Model migration as staged preservation then safety/idiom improvements.
records.limitations: Initial Rust is unsafe and unidiomatic; preprocessor specializes platform choices. Known unsupported/partial constructs include longjmp/setjmp, certain SIMD/builtins, variadics and long double. No runs performed.
records.opensource_status: BSD-3-style root license; bundled portions have separate terms. GitHub license classifier says NOASSERTION, so actual LICENSE was read. Nonarchived; recent default-branch commit verified.
records.inspection_depth: README, pinned known-limitations.md and LICENSE, GitHub metadata/default-branch commit.

records.title: AlphaTrans: A Neuro-Symbolic Compositional Approach for Repository-Level Code Translation and Validation
records.what_transfers: Language-specific normalization; dependency fragments; target type map and compilable skeleton; reverse-call-order translation; original-language tests through GraalVM interoperability before translated tests.
records.limitations: Implemented/evaluated Java→Python. Paper reports 96.40% syntactic correctness but 25.14% source-test-relative functional equivalence among 4,654 evaluable method fragments; correctness remains suite-relative. No reproduction here.
records.opensource_status: Public Intelligent-CAT-Lab/AlphaTrans repository; NCSA license reported by GitHub metadata; research artifact, not established general production translator.
records.inspection_depth: Full publisher paper text, repository README and metadata; source internals not audited.

records.title: ReCodeAgent: A Multi-agent Workflow for Language-Agnostic Translation and Validation of Large-Scale Repositories
records.type: Conference paper with published artifact link
records.what_transfers: Separate analysis, planning, translation and validation roles; use LSP/language tools, explicit third-party-library mapping, target skeleton and coverage-guided checks. Warns against assertion deletion in translated tests.
records.limitations: 118 projects, six languages/four pairs; experiments once and likely pretraining contamination. Language-agnostic design is not evidence for arbitrary pairs or multi-donor fusion. Artifact not downloaded or executed.
records.opensource_status: Latest paper links Zenodo artifact 21842351; its contents/license not verified. Do not use obsolete v1 artifact DOI 19337799 without reason.
records.inspection_depth: v4 abstract, architecture, validation, threats, data-availability sections.

records.title: TransCoder-ST / TransCoder-IR in Facebook Research CodeGen
records.what_transfers: Use executable tests to reject incorrect translations rather than syntax/BLEU alone; compiler representations are another translation bridge. ST documentation covers C++/Java/Python directions; IR documentation includes Rust.
records.limitations: Research toolkit, not general repository fusion. Original TransCoder repository is archived and CC-BY-NC-4.0, unlike successor CodeGen. Main commit inspected is old despite newer repository pushed_at metadata.
records.opensource_status: CodeGen MIT except GfG validation/test data and evaluation scripts CC-BY-SA-2.0; inspect individual artifacts/models before reuse.
records.inspection_depth: Official README, ST/IR docs, paper abstract, metadata and latest-default-branch commit; not executed.

records.title: RepoTransBench: A Real-World Multilingual Benchmark for Repository-Level Code Translation
records.what_transfers: Evaluate entire translated repositories with build/config/dependency/resource behavior and executable tests. Expanded benchmark reports 1,897 samples/13 language pairs; best reported success 32.8%, revealing substantial unresolved work.
records.limitations: Do not substitute old 2024 preprint numbers for expanded 2026 version. README language-count text is internally inconsistent with its named languages/pairs. Public source has no license identified in inspected metadata/root listing; not reuse-cleared. No reproduction.
records.opensource_status: Public repository but license not verified; no detected root license. Research-read only until rights clarified.
records.inspection_depth: Official repository README and metadata, author-institution publication record; full large publisher PDF not retrieved.

records.title: TransLibEval: Demystify Large Language Models’ Capability in Third-party Library-targeted Code Translation
records.what_transfers: Treat third-party-library/API mapping as its own failure surface: library existence, equivalent operation, argument/error behavior and dependency installation. Use parallel normal/edge/exception/type/resource cases.
records.limitations: 200 method-level tasks in Python/Java/C++; primitive interfaces and five tests per task in README, not realistic arbitrary whole systems. Library-focused results do not prove semantic equivalence.
records.opensource_status: Public Xiaozheng03Asada/TransLibEval repository, MIT reported by GitHub metadata; donor-library terms remain separate.
records.inspection_depth: v2 paper methods/error taxonomy, official README and repository metadata; not executed.

records.title: WebAssembly Component Model: WIT contracts
records.what_transfers: Typed component interfaces/worlds, options/results, bounded-width primitives, records/variants and resources as an optional polyglot boundary instead of source translation.
records.limitations: WIT defines contracts, not implementation behavior. Only usable when language tooling/runtime/platform and required host capabilities fit; interface compatibility alone does not prove semantic compatibility.
records.opensource_status: Open WebAssembly/Bytecode Alliance specification and ecosystem; exact chosen runtime/bindgen/component licenses require separate review.
records.inspection_depth: Official WIT reference read; no component compiled/executed.

records.title: Tree-sitter
records.what_transfers: Broad concrete-syntax ingestion, incremental parsing and structural queries, useful before language-aware semantic tools.
records.limitations: Syntax trees do not themselves resolve call/dataflow, dynamic dispatch, state or semantic equivalence. Installed grammar/binding versions matter; some bindings are incomplete/outdated per docs.
records.opensource_status: MIT repository; grammar licenses/support must be checked separately.
records.inspection_depth: Official introduction and repository README/license metadata; no parsing executed.

records.title: Joern code property graphs
records.type: Open-source static analysis and slicing platform
records.what_transfers: Language-normalized graphs of syntax/control/data relations, taint/dataflow queries and slices; useful deeper evidence layer for extraction closure and effects.
records.limitations: Frontend maturity differs: current docs list C/C++/Java very high, JS/Python high, other frontends medium or lower. Homepage list is stale relative to docs. Static edges remain modeled/incomplete evidence, not runtime proof.
records.opensource_status: Apache-2.0; nonarchived with recent default-branch commit verified.
records.inspection_depth: Official documentation overview and repository metadata; frontends/engines not exercised.

supporting_documentation.title: Rust FFI / Rustonomicon
supporting_documentation.what_transfers: ABI, ownership, nullability, callbacks and unwind contracts at retained native boundaries.
supporting_documentation.limitations: Rust/C-centric; does not make foreign code safe or automatically map arbitrary languages.
supporting_documentation.opensource_status: Official open documentation; binding tool and donor licenses separate.
supporting_documentation.inspection_depth: FFI sections on opaque types, nullable pointers and unwinding.

supporting_documentation.title: gRPC core concepts and lifecycle
supporting_documentation.what_transfers: Typed process boundaries with status/deadline/streaming/cancellation semantics.
supporting_documentation.limitations: Client/server can disagree on success; cancellation does not roll back completed side effects. RPC adds operations, serialization and latency.
supporting_documentation.opensource_status: Open-source gRPC ecosystem; chosen library license and versions require pinning.

supporting_documentation.title: CodeQL data-flow analysis and CLI eligibility
supporting_documentation.what_transfers: Queryable semantic relations and local/global dataflow for closure/effect checks.
supporting_documentation.limitations: Model-dependent, language-specific analysis; CLI not blanket-free for private repositories and may need authorized builds. Not an automatic translator.
supporting_documentation.opensource_status: Open query libraries, distinct CLI terms; private-repository eligibility must be checked.
supporting_documentation.inspection_depth: Official dataflow and GitHub CLI terms/eligibility pages.
